e.title: DHARMa
e.summary: 层次模型残差诊断（CRAN 0.5.0）：模拟法缩比残差——GLM/GLMM 过度离散/零膨胀/离群值诊断（精算 GLM 标配）
e.summary_en: Hierarchical model residual diagnostics (CRAN 0.5.0): simulation-based scaled residuals — overdispersion/zero-inflation/outlier tests for GLM/GLMM (actuarial GLM standard)
e.summary_hk: 層次模型殘差診斷（CRAN 0.5.0）：模擬法縮比殘差——GLM/GLMM 過度離散/零膨脹/離群值診斷（精算 GLM 標配）
e.body:
DHARMa（CRAN 0.5.0，Florian Hartig）用模拟法生成可解释的缩比（quantile）残差：GLM/GLMM/GAM 的过度离散、零膨胀、离群值、分布误设检验——精算定价建模的事实标准诊断工具。对 RIAA：GLM 诊断是精算定价的标准步骤——[[insurancerating]]（GLM 定价）与 [[actuare]]（分层模型）生态常配套 DHARMa；缩比残差让计数模型（泊松/负二项）的残差可解释（频率建模必备）；与 [[insurance-calibration]]（校准检验）、[[insurance-monitoring]]（漂移）配套；Hartig 维护的高引包；适合定价模型的诊断环节。

## 同类工具
[[double-lift]]、[[end-to-end-automl-insurance]]、[[ergodic-insurance-limits]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
e.body_en:
DHARMa (CRAN 0.5.0, Florian Hartig) uses a simulation-based approach to create interpretable scaled (quantile) residuals: overdispersion, zero-inflation, outlier and distribution-misspecification tests for GLM/GLMM/GAM — the de facto diagnostic standard in actuarial pricing modelling. For RIAA: GLM diagnostics are a standard step in actuarial pricing — the [[insurancerating]] (GLM pricing) and [[actuare]] (hierarchical models) ecosystems commonly pair with DHARMa; scaled residuals make count-model (Poisson/NB) residuals interpretable (essential for frequency modelling); pairs with [[insurance-calibration]] (calibration tests) and [[insurance-monitoring]] (drift); a highly cited package maintained by Hartig; suits the diagnostic stage of pricing models.

## Similar tools

e.body_hk:
DHARMa（CRAN 0.5.0，Florian Hartig）用模擬法生成可解釋的縮比（quantile）殘差：GLM/GLMM/GAM 的過度離散、零膨脹、離群值、分佈誤設檢驗——精算定價建模的事實標準診斷工具。對 RIAA：GLM 診斷是精算定價的標準步驟——[[insurancerating]]（GLM 定價）與 [[actuare]]（分層模型）生態常配套 DHARMa；縮比殘差讓計數模型（泊松/負二項）的殘差可解釋（頻率建模必備）；與 [[insurance-calibration]]（校準檢驗）、[[insurance-monitoring]]（漂移）配套；Hartig 維護的高引包；適合定價模型的診斷環節。

## 同類工具
